name: Selran Canvas
summary: Page-aware canvas — render manuscript pages, ask MCQ questions inline (clickable in browser or answerable in chat via canvas_answer_mcq), let users select text and attach inline comments Claude resolves, pull highlighted evidence from the Selran Librarian, format citations in any of 100+ medical journal styles via CSL. Browser canvas at localhost:15000 (or SELRAN_CANVAS_PORT). 10 MCP tools. Companion to selran-medical-writer; serves design + data-analysis skills when installed.
